1.3-Manual_Set_Solution_Resistance.comment:
### 🧪 Manual Solution Resistance Setting ($R_s$)

Use this if no EIS test was performed or to use literature/empirical values.

#### 💡 Scenarios
- **Empirical**: Known resistance (e.g., 0.1M KOH ~ $40 \sim 50 \Omega$).
- **Verification**: Compare effect of different resistance values.

> **⚠️ Note**:
> - Unit: **$\Omega$**.
> - Manual value overrides `ir_from_eis_csv`.
